normative_extracts.quote: Speculation rules allow authors to declaratively specify URLs to prefetch or prerender in a background browsing context before navigation.
document.prerendering is true while a document is prerendering and transitions to false when the page is activated via prerenderingchange.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Spawns a hidden background renderer tab to fetch, parse, and paint a predicted next navigation, swapping it atomically on click for near-zero LCP.

production_failures.symptom: Analytics pageviews and ad impressions double-count or fire for unvisited pages
production_failures.root_cause: Tracking scripts executed during the hidden prerender phase before the user actually clicked the link.
production_failures.mitigation: Gate analytics beacons on !document.prerendering and defer until the prerenderingchange event fires.

production_failures.symptom: Aggressive eager prerender rules exhaust origin servers and user mobile data
production_failures.root_cause: Using eagerness: immediate on a list of 20 product links triggered 20 full-page background renders per pageview.
production_failures.mitigation: Use eagerness: moderate (hover/pointerdown) or conservative (pointerdown) and restrict prerender to high-probability routes.
